item.title: Smart Cities: New advances in Urban planning and Policies
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on recent developments in smart cities and their application to urban planning and policy-making. The collection seeks to explore innovative approaches and advancements in how technology and strategic planning can enhance urban environments and governance.
